summary: VLA-Radar V3.0 2026-10-27 original-source catch-up: p145 GeoMem-VLA geometry/memory causal episode (Qwen3-VL+VGGT), p146 VLA-Delta physical state transition supervision, p147 SimPT stage-guided intervention post-training; 3 complete original arXiv v1 deep reads, official resources limited to author-verified p145/p146, 6 source-scoped paper-table tracks and 17 original quantitative rows. LIBERO/RoboTwin/SimPT seven-task expert recovery are separate metrics. Retain counterexamples: SimPT FlowPRO PG decreases 76.07%->71.86%, and RECAP-CF-LPF Naive unreported. Author-reported results, not independent reproduction or official benchmark submissions. Full four-lane and bilingual news discovery still partial; 2026-10-04 lastSuccessfulSearchAt retained. Branch admin protection and publisher DOI remain unresolved without evidence.
